video_title: Micah Nori Media Availability | Oct. 6, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori on rotation plans for the upcoming back-to-back games
quotes.excerpt: My guess is they'll probably play a normal first half rotation, minute-wise, and then probably everybody will get one stint in the second half.
quotes.quote: The one thing everybody is going to play. The way I look at it, because we just have the four games, we also have a back-to-back. My guess is they'll probably play a normal first half rotation, minute-wise, and then probably everybody will get one stint in the second half. So you're probably looking at the majority of guys between 18 to 20 minutes. Again, just because we have a back-to-back, I don't know how much we're going to play those guys in those back-to-backs if everybody will play both of those, but that's the way we'll go tomorrow.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori says the Blazers plan to limit players to 18 to 20 minutes in the upcoming back to back games to manage workloads during the preseason

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori on integrating Ja Morant and Damian Lillard
quotes.excerpt: I'm really curious just to see how this group incorporates Ja and Dame.
quotes.quote: I'm really curious just to see how this group that was a playoff team last year incorporates Ja and Dame, two guys that are dynamic pieces to add to this group. So I'm excited. I'm also looking forward to another year of Deni, coming with the year that he's had. And Deni, we're asking him to be more of a two-way guy because we don't have to rely on him for all the offensive stuff that this team had to, down the stretch of last year because of injuries.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori says the team is asking Deni Avdija to be more of a two way player this season since they no longer have to rely on him for all the offensive production

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori on team chemistry and player development in training camp
quotes.excerpt: You see Ja getting into the paint, you see Dame coming off, you see Donovan protecting the rim.
quotes.quote: You see Ja getting into the paint, and whether he be finishing or finding a guy. You see Dame coming off, whether it be in transition, or coming off of catch and shoot. You see Donovan protecting the rim. You see Jalen being all over the place, covering up for everybody's mistakes. You see Jayson being a Swiss Army knife. You've seen Scoot. Scoot's been really good and City has both been really good in camp as far as just being the best versions of themselves at both ends of the floor.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori highlights the versatility of the roster in training camp noting Jayson Tatum is acting as a Swiss Army knife while Ja Morant and Damian Lillard are already making an impact

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Micah Nori on the ease of coaching a veteran-led team
quotes.excerpt: It's been easier and the reason it's been easier is because of the vets in the group.
quotes.quote: It's been easier and the reason it's been easier is because of the vets in the group that we have. The players have bought in, they've allowed us to coach them. We have really good vets. We have really good practice players. A lot of times guys will go through the motions and just coast through practice and there hasn't been any of that, which has increased the competition in practice.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori credits the veteran leadership on the Blazers for making the coaching process easier this year noting that the team has avoided coasting during practice
